stemMd: A rhombus has diagonals of lengths 10 and 24. What is its perimeter?
explanationMd: Rhombus diagonals bisect at right angles. A side is the hypotenuse with legs 5 and 12, hence 13. Four sides give perimeter 52.

distractorRationale.b: This adds the diagonals rather than finding a side.
